Open thread • Replies: 75 • Updated: 2026-08-23 20:51 UTC

OP

But which one?

> Unbreakable Rule 1: Breaking out from the 1D 200sma after a bear market starts the next bull run

> Unbreakable Rule 2: The 4 year cycle. If this is the start of the next bullrun, that means the bottom was 58k two months ago. And that would mean that the bear market was only 6 months long, when it was supposed to be about 12.

These rules are incompatible at such an early month, so one of them is failing right now. We are in uncharted waters.

NOTES
Last cycle we saw another 'unbreakable' rule break: the bear market crashing below the weekly 200sma.

I think the 1D 200sma is the "weaker" rule, and more likely to break.

The 1D 200sma breakout, if we don't crash, leads to a golden cross about a month later. I can ignore the 1D 200sma but I would not fuck with the golden cross.

FRONTRUNNING
Everyone is now aware of the 4 year cycle, and trading accordingly. This causes 'frontrunning', which accelerates and potentially breaks the cycle.

But we have seen this once before. In early 2024 everyone tried to frontrun the bull market, which resulted in BTC passing the previous ATH way too early. People were calling for an immediate bull market peak and saying that the 4 year cycle was broken. But the 4 year cycle was stronger than the masses. BTC crabbed for an entire year, resetting the schedule of the cycle back to normal.

I think it's likely we see the same thing happen here, and we crab/dump into octoBEAR as originally planned. But if we can hold these prices until a golden cross happens, I'd bet on that most of all.
